text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's Chrono Genesis! Chrono Genesis has 
conquered the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first-ever Tiara Umamusume to achieve 
a 3-peat Grand Prix victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa, amazing, amazing! Chrono-chan, 
you're the first in history!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... As a Tiara Umamusume, that is...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The next one will truly be an 
unprecedented first for all Umamusume, 
right? Four consecutive Grand Prix 
victories!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, I wanted to be the first one to 
achieve the historic triple-category 
sweep!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Chrono-chan beat me to it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if it's an unconditional, 
unprecedented first... there's always a 
chance someone might beat you to it.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah, right! Alright, time for a comeback!
choice_data_list:
Hmm, the level they're competing at is 
incredible...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed... If the me from three years 
ago knew, she'd be utterly shocked.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The reason I was able to come this far... 
is because of everyone... and our shared 
goal of defining our generation."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah, me too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —And you too, Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Today, standing in the winner's 
circle... when I spotted you among the 
fans, Trainer...—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Being able to welcome three consecutive 
Grand Prix victories together felt like a 
true miracle...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"All the smiling fans... and Trainer-san 
watching over me..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...It made me realize once again... just 
how much I truly love the view of this 
Grand Prix..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...That's why in the Arima Kinen, too...!

Fufu, that's great to hear! In that case, 
I can get my revenge at the Arima!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who said that was a remarkably 
petite horse girl. She was voted into the 
Takarazuka Kinen by the fans, and is in 
the same generation as well.

text_block_list.name: Exceptionally Petite Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And they say it's impossible because of my 
track record, or that it's too tough 
because of my small frame, but I'm going 
to prove that's just not true!

text_block_list.name: Exceptionally Petite Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Just like Chrono-chan!

text_block_list.name: Exceptionally Petite Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Well then, everyone's waiting for me. 
We're right in the middle of a photo 
shoot!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Whoa, as expected of someone so popular!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: That's a declaration of war, Chrono-chan!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I am honored. Of course, I intend 
to accept your challenge...! Because—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Because we... are going to achieve four 
consecutive Grand Prix victories...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Right...? Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis's history is still only 
midway through. Her hoofprints will 
continue on into the future—
